description: This file implements a distributed mutex mechanism for Mattermost plugins, allowing multiple plugin instances across a cluster to coordinate access using a key-value store with refresh and expiration logic.

classes.name: Mutex
classes.description: A cluster-wide mutex for plugin synchronization, based on key-value store with refresh capability.

methods.name: NewMutex
methods.description: Creates a new Mutex instance with a specified key, ensuring the key is valid.

methods.name: tryLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock atomically, returning success status.

methods.name: refreshLock
methods.description: Refreshes the lock's expiration time to maintain ownership.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex, blocking until successful.

methods.name: LockWithContext
methods.description: Locks the mutex with context cancellation support.
